result.stdout:
Usage: agentic-roslyn-tool <command> [options]

Commands:
  split-types   Split C# files that declare more than one top-level type (SA1402).

split-types options:
  --input <dir|file|csv|list|->    A directory to scan, one .cs file, a CSV with a 'file' column,
                                   a text file with one path per line, or '-' to read paths from stdin.
  --repo-root <path>               Repository root used for git operations. Defaults to the current directory.
  --manifest <path>                Path to the manifest CSV. Defaults to sa1402-split-manifest.csv beside a list
                                   input, or in --repo-root for a directory or stdin input.
  --phase plan|renames|content     Which phase to run. Defaults to content.
  --dry-run                        Shorthand for --phase plan. Cannot be combined with --phase.
  --json                           Print one JSON report to stdout instead of CSV.
  --require-header <text>          Require and prepend this file header. Off by default.
  --exclude <path-substring>       Skip inputs whose path contains this substring. Repeatable.
  --help, -h                       Show help.

Exit codes: 0 no failures, 1 a file failed, 2 bad command line, 3 the run could not complete.
Standard output carries the data (CSV or JSON); a one-line summary goes to standard error.
